part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"screen all features open-loop first by steering and measuring divergence between steered and unsteered predicted actions on a fixed buffer of recorded observations, then pay closed-loop rollouts only for the top-k features by effect size","reason":"Reorders screening to open-loop divergence on recorded observations; closed-loop rollouts confirm only top-k, so compute buys feature coverage."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"replace binary success with a continuous physical readout (wrist force/torque trace, contact timing, peak grasp force) on a short instrumented real-robot task such as grasping a compliant object","reason":"Measures force slopes instead of binary success, buying contact-level evidence; trials remain full closed-loop real grasps, not open-loop recorded-observation scoring."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"before sweeping anything new, calibrate the sim-to-real transfer function of steering effect sizes on rigid tasks where both sides are cheap","reason":"Changes objective to transfer calibration so later compute buys validated screening; question itself uses closed-loop sim rollouts plus real trials."}]}
